description: The C-HR (TOYOTA_CHR_TSS2) and Yaris (TOYOTA_YARIS) radar-ACC platforms carry the same ARS510 bus as the RAV4: one minute each from three opendbc test routes (logs from comma's public CI store), read with the repo's log reader and run through the acc interface (opendbc branch ars510-acc, with RAV4 car params) and the fused decoder (upstream/ars510_radar.py). Their radar part numbers differ from the RAV4's (8821F0R01100 / 8821F0R03100). Mostly parked or on an empty road, so these minutes show the bus, not driving behaviour.

fused_object_list.note: 0-2 objects per record on an empty road at 23 m/s
no 0xB4 wheel-speed frame on this car, so the filter has no ego speed

dbc_signals_vs_reference_decoder.signals: every signal of ACC_TARGET_1-4 in upstream/toyota_tss2_ars510.dbc through opendbc's CANParser against ars510.support (parse_acc_target, parse_0x239, parse_0x23b)

consequence: The community integration enables both platforms for testing (installer hook ARS510_PLATFORMS; the Yaris runs acc whatever the profile, since it sends no 0xB4 wheel speed), and the upstream acc proposal (upstream/opendbc_ars510.patch) gives every radar-ACC platform the radar DBC toyota_tss2_ars510. Drives in traffic on a C-HR or Yaris are still to come.
